summary: Key synced inventory listing links by VIN and rekey legacy links.
reason: Inventory sync extracts HTML links with URL and slug fields, not a vin field; parse their vehicle URL before using a descriptive name as the storage key, migrate old links, and preserve cached full details when a link is synced again.
validated_outcome: A normal HTML sync supports local VIN lookup; a v9 store rekeys old links without losing hydrated vehicle or full detail records; full Go tests, vet, builds, skill verification, and diff check pass.
